features.frost: ground-frost regions (skin temp <=0 C) as contour rings [[lon,lat],...]
features.front: precip areas (>= 1.0 mm/h) as contour rings [[lon,lat],...] (grey fill + wiggly outline)
features.wind: migration-band wind (strongest of 925 hPa) >= 5 m/s (sampled), [lon,lat,u,v] m/s
features.wgrid: full migration-band wind (strongest of 925 hPa), 6-cell stride, row-major deci-m/s ints (null = no coverage); for particle advection
